        hidden_effect = { location:mitilene = { if = { limit = { owner = c:BYZ } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_cw2_gattilusio_fief years = -1 mode = replace } } } location:molyvos = { if = { limit = { owner = c:BYZ } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_cw2_gattilusio_fief years = -1 mode = replace } } } }
        ai_chance = { base = 80 }
    }
    option = {
        name = oe_cw2.20.b
        add_prestige = prestige_mild_penalty
        ai_chance = { base = 20 }
    }
}

        ai_chance = { base = 50 }
    }

        ai_chance = { base = 50 }
